description: This file defines functions and interfaces related to the HTTP/1.x protocol layer within the lighttpd server. It includes function declarations for sending informational and header responses, receiving headers, reading request body, and checking connection timeouts.

methods.name: h1_send_1xx
methods.description: Sends an informational (1xx) HTTP response to the client during a request.

methods.name: h1_send_headers
methods.description: Sends HTTP headers for a request.

methods.name: h1_recv_headers
methods.description: Receives HTTP headers from a client request.

methods.name: h1_reqbody_read
methods.description: Reads the request body for a HTTP/1.x request.

methods.name: h1_check_timeout
methods.description: Checks for timeout conditions on a connection.
